domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 桥墩基础或墩体发生的下沉变形。
usage_overview: 在基础沉降影响下的列车—桥梁—轨道分析中，可作为支承位移输入，用于考察沉降引起的相邻桥跨及轨道附加变形，为分析列车通过过渡段时的行车安全提供依据。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Pier settlement Transition zone High-speed railway Vehicle riding safety Rail deformation Time-frequency analysis A B S T R A C T The settlement of piers and subgrade bending deformation are widely recognized as common issues in the transition zones of high-speed railway bridges.
